name: Occipital Neuralgia
definition: Paroxysmal stabbing or shooting pain in the distribution of the greater, lesser or third occipital nerves, often with local tenderness or sensory disturbance.

typical: Pain may radiate toward vertex or eye

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is primarily clinical after excluding secondary causes.
investigations.MRI: MRI brain/cervical imaging is used when atypical features or red flags exist.

green: Education and avoidance of persistent provocative pressure
Treat coexisting cervical dysfunction when present
amber: Occipital nerve block or medication for neuralgic pain requires individualized clinical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shirah-shoola/Vata neuralgic phenotype may be documented as correlation only.

patientEducation.summary: Paroxysmal stabbing or shooting pain in the distribution of the greater, lesser or third occipital nerves, often with local tenderness or sensory disturbance.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
